title: STARTEX — Flight to Nowhere

fields.staffing: Full shifts in Operations, Maintenance and IT
fields.narration: STARTEX. This is an exercise. It is 09:00 AM on a busy Thursday at North Coast Regional Airport. The terminal is bustling with travelers, gates are at full capacity, and flight operations are running on schedule. The Airport Operational Database (AODB) is active and feeding data to FIDS, BHS, and the PA system. All systems are nominal. Begin operations.

status.note: All displays showing real-time flight data
